what_happened: The job added owner decision briefs rendered from open proposals in xtask/src/decisions.rs. The verifier rejected it at the final verdict. One of 9 acceptance criteria was unmet: the `cargo test -p xtask` criterion that a test builds briefs from two fixture proposals differing in title, rung, source and evidence, and asserts the briefs differ. The one major finding says the two fixtures (tests::item and tests::fixtures) share the same source, `docs/design/x.md`. No test therefore shows the brief's source line comes from the proposal. No failed checks are listed. The rest of the work was not reported as faulty.
cause: The criterion lists four fields that must differ, but nothing makes the producer check each field against its own fixture data before finishing. The test helper `item` hard-codes one source, so the fixtures pass a "differs" assertion on the other fields while one field stays constant. Only the verifier compares a criterion field by field against the test code, and that happens at the final verdict. The producer has no self-check that maps each named field in a criterion to a test that varies it. This is an inference, since the producer's report is not in the stored fields. This job is a follow-up to the earlier rejection in which the brief content was fixed text (20261103-074940-hcey). That earlier case is in a different class, so it is not listed.
prevention: Add a producer default: before finishing, for every criterion that names several fields or inputs, list each one and point to the test line that varies it. For a "briefs differ" test, every fixture field named in the criterion must take a different value, and the test must assert that each corresponding output line differs. A cheap pre-verification pass over criteria against the diff would catch the gap before the final verdict. It would also catch the same kind of gap in other jobs.
proposed_request: In xtask/src/decisions.rs tests, make the decision-brief tests use two fixture proposals that differ in every field named in the criterion: title, rung, source (for example docs/design/a.md and docs/design/b.md) and evidence. Add assertions that the rendered brief's title, rung, source line and evidence line each differ between the two briefs and each match their own proposal's value. The briefs must contain no fixed cost, risk or 'Approve' text. Change only the tests and test helpers, not the renderer, unless the new assertions expose a real defect. `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test -p xtask` must pass, and add a CHANGELOG entry.
